newsitem.title: USA: BPA raises Sat-Mon power prices by $1.00-2.75/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA raises Sat-Mon power prices by $1.00-2.75/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised prices for surplus power for Saturday through Monday delivery by $1.00 to 2.75 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Friday.
BPA continued to offer both firm and non-firm power during peak and off-peak hours, limiting firm on-peak power to 500 megawatts (MW) for Saturday and Monday.
For Monday, firm heavy-load power was offered at $18.50 per MWh for Northwest deliveries, up from $17.00 for Friday, while California-Oregon border (COB) power was offered at $19.50, up from $18.00.
Firm power during light-load hours on Monday was offered at $14.25 per MWh for Friday, up from $12.75.
Non-firm power during light-load hours on Monday was offered between $14.75 and 16.75.
Monday non-firm power during heavy-load hours was offered at $17.75 to $20.75 per MWh for Northwest deliveries, while COB deliveries were offered at $18.75 to $21.75.
